name: print-social-monochrome-portfolio-closing-slide
title: Wide-tech-type closing slide with QR codes
whatItIs: A three-part portfolio ending: a white 'a few words about me' block in wide geometric type, a black contact band with square social icons, and a huge 'For watching' with the middle letters fading to grey above two QR codes and a small blue logo.
whatItMeans: Minimal and self-assured, like a designer's sign-off; big type and monochrome keep attention on the call to scan.
techniques: Set a huge closing phrase in wide techno-rounded type with a gradient fade across letters.
Alternate white and black bands to separate topics.
Use giant QR codes as the main graphic with tiny captions.
Keep social links as small lowercase text and square white icons.

vocabulary.definition: Wide letterforms built from circles and lines.
Letters that fade from solid to transparent.
A scannable code as the main action.
